normalization: per subject/user unlabeled zscore for every feature block
decision: pre-registered: accept only if five-repeat mean delta AUC >= +0.005, delta F1 >= 0, delta DEP AUC >= 0, and fixed002 delta AUC > 0; otherwise stop and do not tune
strict_single_window: not the primary historical protocol; included as documented future/independent control because control_600 reuses historical subject zscore protocol
screening_note: fixed theta-beta PAC, 18 bins, 8 within-window circular surrogates; screening configuration, not a full PAC search
